exact_patch_feasibility.reason: existing decomposed SWA path applies RoPE then quantize_and_insert_k_cache; local cache ABI stores448 NoPE as FP8 block64 UE8M0 plus64 RoPE BF16. Exact V4.1 reference window QAT is full512 FP8 block32; feeding QDQ values through current writer double-quantizes NoPE and does not preserve the tested representation. Preserving exact QAT requires changing cache page format, writer and gather/reader, while compressed/indexer contracts also differ.

decision: Do not apply a speculative/non-equivalent patch. Preserve both full-model localization windows. Enter R4 isolated DS4 V4.1/gfx1151 compatibility/build gates.
